messages:
incident-bot: Pager: charge-shadow anomaly detected in collector-agg (eu1). count delta > 20% vs baseline for last 2h. Potential overage flags to customers. Runbook: /runbooks/charge-shadow. Pager P1.

sophie: oncall here, ack. I'm pulling latest aggregates and checking emitter pipeline. @raj can you check kafka consumer lag for collector-topic?

raj: checking now. there's a consumer lag spike on partition 12-15, consumer group collector-agg-cg. lag ~1.2M messages. likely backpressure from a recent deploy?

marco: i rolled out collector-scaler bump at 03:40 UTC, might be related. Can we rollback?

sophie: don't rollback yet. let's replay head and confirm whether counts are duplicated or delayed. running query:

```
SELECT SUM(count) FROM charge_agg WHERE ts > now()-3h GROUP BY window(1m);
```

sophie: query shows sudden drop at 03:42, then catch-up burst at 04:05. That aligns with consumer lag/resume. Customers received transient overage flags between 04:06-04:20 (approx).

jess: notifying CS: #customer-alerts. draft msg: "We're investigating alerts for unexpected overage flags in the last 2 hours; billing not finalised yet." :rotating_light: 

raj: consumer lag root cause: GC pauses on collector-agg worker due to memory regression in 0.9.2. patch in progress. restarting group nodes now.

incident-bot: Action: restart triggered by raj at 1740013275

sophie: restarts completed, consumer lag cleared. Backfill started. Estimate time to catchup: 18m. Suspect duplicate emission causing overflag; prepping dedupe job to ignore replayed offsets older than first_commit_ts.

marco: enabling temporary suppression of overage alerting for affected alert group (billing-overflag-eu1) until recon finishes :warning: 

jess: CS notified, asked to hold customer emails until we confirm scope. Note: only ~12 customers got flags; two have active usage near tier boundary.

sophie: Mitigation summary: restarted workers, applied GC patch, backfill in progress, alert suppression enabled. Next: run one-off dedupe, run full reconciliation against billing-warehouse, then lift suppressions.

raj: ETA for backfill completion 30 mins (1740014950). Will post final reconciliation snapshot when done.

sophie: closing triage notes in incident board: https://redwood.in/incident/1740013141. Marking as mitigated for live impact; follow-up: postmortem and billing credit evaluation.
